Pascal (pascal.app, linked from its SPC page; legal name reported as Pascal Group Inc.); AI platform for on-demand building maintenance and repairs that builds a digital twin of each property and dispatches vetted pros. Founders Julien Brissonneau (CEO) and Aymeric Rabot (CTO); founded 2025; SPC lists no city. Apart from the SPC Founder Fellowship check (accelerator-style, not a priced round), no press release or reputable news of a round was found. A tracker (Crunchbase snippet, not used) shows a seed-stage record with no amount or investors; unverified. Not to be confused with Pascal AI Labs (investment research AI), which announced a separate $3.1M seed.
